notes: The breadboard image is labelled with rows j-f at the top and e-a at the bottom, so the top half is catalogue bank 'b' (rows f-j) and the bottom half is bank 't' (rows a-e).
Column and row positions are estimated from the image: the blue wire is at 3b.f, the resistor spans 3b.g to 6b.g, the LED anode is at 6b.i, the LED cathode is at 8b.i, and the black wire is at 8b.g.

The potentiometer is drawn as a blue trimmer. It is modelled as potentiometer-10k, with the left pin (column 22) as GND, the centre pin (column 23) as SIG, and the right pin (column 24) as VCC. The pot straddles the centre gap, so the centre pin is in the top half and the outer pins are in the bottom half.
The Uno has several GND pins, so the power-header GND wire is assigned GND.1 and the digital-header GND wire (next to AREF) is assigned GND.3.
The LED anode (the longer, bent leg) connects through the resistor to pin 9. The cathode goes to ground.
The pot's 5V wire goes to the right pin (column 24) and its ground wire to the left pin (column 22), as in the image.
